svg.text: Opus 5.5 at each effort level, by task
orange: best level; hollow: below an earlier level
green: GPT-6 Astra (triangles: index at each level; dashed *: launch score, effort not labeled)
Share of each task's gain, from low effort to the best level reached
Each cell shows the score and the percent of the gain; 100% marks the best level on that task.
svg.title: Opus 5.5 by effort level and task
svg.desc: Six panels of Opus 5.5 score at low, medium, high, xhigh and max effort for the index and five benchmarks, with a heat map of the share of each task's gain captured at each level.
